lines.sub: Sirf 3 products se shuruaat. Aur 3 saal baad, 1 arab dollar tak ki deal.
Hailey Bieber ne apna skincare brand launch kiya. 50 nahi, sirf 3 products.
Par dikkat ye thi ki celebrity brands ek ke baad ek flop ho rahe the.
To Rhode ne cream nahi, ek look becha: glazed donut skin.
Phir aaya asli hit: ek phone case, jiske peeche lip tint phansta hai.
Har haath mein wahi case. Har photo mein free ad.
Aur kam stock, chhote drops. Sab minuton mein sold out.
3 saal baad, e.l.f. Beauty ne Rhode ko 1 arab dollar tak mein khareed liya.
Sabak: kam products aur ek yaadgaar cheez, bade catalogue se zyada bikti hai.
Aisi aur kahaniyon ke liye, follow karo!
